key_insight: A simple, interpretable ICU risk model using routine cumulative care data can dynamically re-stratify patients for multidrug-resistant bacterial infection risk during the ICU stay.
clinical_relevance: This tool may help ICU teams identify higher-risk patients earlier and support timely prevention or stewardship decisions, using variables that are relatively easy to collect.
method: Retrospective ICU cohort from one hospital (2023–2026) split 7:3 into training and validation sets.
Selected predictors with Boruta, then built a multivariable logistic regression nomogram.
Compared performance with several machine-learning models and added an online R Shiny calculator.
evidence_signal: In validation, the logistic regression model achieved an AUC of 0.772 (95% CI 0.733–0.812), with additional ROC, DCA, and SHAP-based evaluation.
watch_item: Single-center retrospective data may limit generalizability, and the model should be externally validated before wider clinical use.
paper_title: Development and validation of a dynamic risk stratification tool for predicting multidrug-resistant bacterial infections in ICU patients: A clinical prediction model and web-based calculator
